dogecoin.text:
Look at that, $DOGE HODLers: #ÐogeCoin’s crossed the 40¢ threshold! I’m sure all of you following @dogecoin must be proud+excited this morning!

Think it holds? Seems that Mark Cuban thinks so. Pretty interesting to see how value changes on the whim of a tweet.

I should invest. https://t.co/N6QgqYbeOK
If $DOGE can present itself as a more efficient, secure, environmentally-friendly, why can’t it be worth $12k a coin someday soon?
Keep waiting. $DOGE will hit $12k before that happens.

Seriously, why does @RobinhoodApp always seem to undergo maintenance whenever ÐōgeCoin rallies? This has happened far too many times now for it to be a coincidence. It seems almost orchestrated. What happens if $DOGE crosses the $10, $100, $1,000, or even $10-20-30k threshold?

Honest question for all you #Doge lovers out there: Suppose $DOGE decides to establish a mining cap (like $BTC/#Bitcoin) + the most environmentally friendly mining mechanism around. Does ÐōgeCoin then position itself to spike in value or does that not make much of a difference?

How convenient for RobinHood—as $DOGE continues to slide further and further down, conveniently-scheduled maintenance means that ÐōgeCoin HODLers can’t sell off their coins, resulting in chaotic losses for thousands of amateur investors. Too many coincidences have happened. https://t.co/Q3gYJR0IjD

I mean, cool, but unless $DOGE decides to become a major player again, I’m not sure ÐōgeCoin becomes more than a meme coin. I saw its rise and precipitous fall within a weeks. Would have been nice to have witnessed some new millionaires, even if I’m still on the outside. 🤷🏾‍♂️
